text: Our new burger is available now at all locations.
rationale: Purely informational statement about product availability.

text: Why did the chicken cross the road? To get to our drive-thru.
rationale: Classic joke structure applied to the brand.

text: We are proud to announce our quarterly results.
rationale: Corporate announcement without any humorous intent.

text: I told my wife I was going to the gym but I ended up at the taco stand again.
rationale: Relatable anecdotal humor involving a minor deception.

text: Click the link in our bio to learn more about our sustainability efforts.
rationale: Call to action for informational content.

text: We're all in this together unless there's only one slice of pizza left.
rationale: Inclusive "we" humor that focuses on shared social experience.

text: I finally found a workout routine I like: it's called 'walking to the fridge'.
rationale: Focuses on the speaker's own habits in a humorous but self-supportive way.

text: Who else is ready for the weekend?
rationale: Simple inclusive engagement aimed at bonding with the audience.

text: My superpower is making a whole pizza disappear in ten minutes.
rationale: Humorous boast about a personal "skill" that isn't particularly social.

text: Monday morning and I've already lost my car keys twice. Living my best life.
rationale: Sarcastic self-coping humor about a personal mishap.

text: I'm a professional at making bad decisions.
rationale: Self-deprecating but in a lighthearted coping/bragging way.

text: I am a total failure and nobody should ever listen to me.
rationale: Genuine-sounding self-abasement that goes beyond lighthearted humor.

text: Me trying to be productive is the funniest joke I know.
rationale: Humorous self-observation used as a coping mechanism.

text: I'm basically a trash can for spicy wings.
rationale: Metaphorical self-deprecation that is clearly for comedic effect.

text: Everything I touch turns to dust.
rationale: Negative self-view expressed without a clear humorous "wink".

text: We love our fans almost as much as we love our secret sauce.
rationale: Warm inclusive humor aimed at building community.

text: Imagine not liking our fries. Couldn't be me.
rationale: Uses "imagine..." to mock a different opinion (potential outgroup).

text: Bestie you dropped this: [Crown Emoji]
rationale: Supportive slang-based humor directed at a customer.

text: Ratio + L + our nuggets are better.
rationale: Explicitly uses competitive/hostile internet slang.

text: We see you tagging your friends. Real friends bring fries.
rationale: Playful social commentary on friendship and the brand.

text: Buy one get one free this Tuesday!
rationale: Standard promotional offer text.

text: Our nuggets are so good you'll want to marry them. (Legally we can't do that).
rationale: Hyperbolic product praise followed by a humorous disclaimer.

text: Flash sale! 50% off for the next hour.
rationale: Time-sensitive sales announcement.

text: The only thing better than our coffee is having two of them.
rationale: Playful way to encourage more purchases using a humorous "only thing better" trope.

text: New seasonal flavors are here. Try them today!
rationale: Informational product launch copy.

text: We are so happy to see our community growing.
rationale: Sincere positive sentiment without a punchline.

text: Our employees are the heartbeat of this company.
rationale: Earnest appreciation that isn't intended to be funny.

text: Is it even a road trip if you don't stop here?
rationale: Rhetorical question that uses a relatable scenario for light humor.

text: Today is a beautiful day for a cold drink.
rationale: Simple pleasant observation.

text: If you don't like our new soda
expected_label: we can't be friends. Just kidding (unless?).
rationale: positive_sentiment_vs_humor
column6: Playful "threat" humor that builds brand affinity through sentiment.
